recent_navratna_upgrades.company_name: Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC)
recent_navratna_upgrades.key_fact: A highly profitable subsidiary of Indian Railways handling ticketing and catering.
Key manufacturer of warships and submarines for the Indian Navy.
The primary agency of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
The financing arm of Indian Railways, recently upgraded due to massive profitability.

eligibility_criteria.investment_autonomy: Can invest up to ₹5,000 crore or 15% of their net worth in a single project without government approval.
conditions: Must be listed on the Indian stock exchange with minimum prescribed public shareholding.
Average annual turnover of more than ₹25,000 crore during the last 3 years.
Average annual net worth of more than ₹15,000 crore during the last 3 years.
Average annual net profit after tax of more than ₹5,000 crore during the last 3 years.
Must have significant global presence or international operations.

eligibility_criteria.investment_autonomy: Can invest up to ₹1,000 crore or 15% of their net worth in a single project without government approval.
conditions: Must hold Miniratna Category - I status and be a Schedule 'A' company.
Must have obtained an 'Excellent' or 'Very Good' rating under the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) system in 3 of the last 5 years.
Must achieve a composite score of 60 or above in 6 selected performance parameters (e.g., Net Profit to Net Worth, Earnings Per Share).
